Construct a koine pass

Source: R/pass.R
koine_pass.Rd

Construct a koine pass

Usage

koine_pass(
  formula,
  data,
  family,
  required_outputs = c("posterior", "log_likelihood"),
  seed = 1L,
  obs_id = NULL,
  resources = list(allowed_tiers = 1L),
  prior = NULL
)

Arguments

formula

A model formula. Population-level terms, optionally with lme4-style random intercepts: a single (1 | g), or the breeder-standard multi-environment-trial (MET) structure of two crossed or nested random intercepts (1 | variety) + (1 | trial). Richer random-effects structure (random slopes, correlated effects, more than two groupings) is parsed and flagged unsupported so the battery abstains non-silently rather than fitting the wrong model. Whether two groupings are crossed or nested is resolved from the data, never from the formula.

data

A data frame holding every column referenced in formula.

family

A base-R family object or a known family name; wrapped into an evaluable family_spec().

required_outputs

Character subset of c("posterior", "log_likelihood", "posterior_predictive", "sample_stats").

seed

Integer master seed; per-lens seeds are derived from it.

obs_id

Optional character vector of observation ids (defaults to obs_0001-style labels of length nrow(data)).

resources

A list with allowed_tiers (subset of 1:3) and optional budgets; defaults to tier 1 only.

prior

Optional structured prior table (unused by the DRAM lens, which uses its own weakly-informative default; reserved for later lenses).

Value

A validated object of class koine_pass.

Examples

d <- data.frame(y = rnorm(20), x = rnorm(20))
koine_pass(y ~ x, d, gaussian())
#> <koine pass>
#>   formula : y ~ x
#>   family  : gaussian / identity
#>   N       : 20
#>   outputs : posterior, log_likelihood
#>   ir_hash : 8ee2601d68fb...
